primary_mask_contract.authoritative_core_mask: all unique P4 core-owned supervised rows
primary_mask_contract.loss_mask: all authoritative core rows for the primary P8 objective
primary_mask_contract.reason: strict four-hop supervision retains only 106 of 62243 high-redshift galaxies and cannot define the mandatory four-shell primary metric

evaluation_scope.same_catalogue_blocked_folds: spatial target generalization with a globally observed representation; cross-fold label use is forbidden but label-free graph context is available
evaluation_scope.fresh_graph_induction: reserved for P10 independent-phase catalogues constructed separately

graphnet_control.name: G-PATCH protocol control
graphnet_control.purpose: isolate the patch training protocol from architecture changes
graphnet_control.receiver_only_status: separately named optional challenger after the control; never a post-hoc replacement

feature_transform_contract.forbidden: per-patch medians, Box-Cox fits, or standardization
feature_transform_contract.si_medians: fit per cap on authoritative training-fold nodes for each rotation and freeze
feature_transform_contract.box_cox: fit on authoritative training-core nodes only and freeze
feature_transform_contract.edge_transform: fit edge median/log standardization on training-fold internal edges only and freeze
feature_transform_contract.blind_application: apply training-ensemble transforms unchanged to validation, blind phases, and DESI

canonical_arrays.node_features.npy: P2b parent graph node features copied unchanged
canonical_arrays.incident_edge_id.npy: canonical pair IDs at both endpoints

patch_arrays.parent_node_id: sorted immutable global parent node IDs
patch_arrays.authoritative_core_mask: primary supervised and scored core rows

dependency_contract.dependency_hops: literal graph hops required for complete-graph parity

production_gpu_parity.interpretation: GPU float32 reduction partition tolerance, not bitwise equality
